# Project instructions

This is a small Flask/SQLAlchemy teaching prototype.

Before implementing a feature:
- read the requirements in `requirements/`;
- treat the UML class diagram as the structural design scaffold;
- treat the UML sequence diagram as the behavioural design scaffold;
- preserve the user-story acceptance criteria;
- keep business logic out of Flask routes where reasonably possible.
- never commit secrets

After implementation:
- run the complete test suite;
- fix failures before claiming completion.
